name: CSP reports
summary: Content Security Policy violation reports in the logs: hosts the browsers block for the first time in 7 days, and jumps in the hourly report count.
needs: An Elasticsearch index or data stream that holds only the CSP report logs, one report per log line with the report JSON in the message field, plain or escaped, compact or with spaces, in the Reporting API or the older report-uri shape.

placeholders.label: Elasticsearch
placeholders.help: The Elasticsearch instance that holds the CSP report logs.

placeholders.label: Site
placeholders.help: A short name for the site in the check names, ids and card texts, such as shop.

placeholders.label: Index
placeholders.help: The index or data stream that holds only the CSP report logs, such as logs-csp-*. A wide pattern such as logs-* makes every pass scan all logs of the last 8 days.

checks.name: CSP ${name} new blocked host
checks.query:
FROM ${index}
| WHERE @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?end) - 24 hours - 7 days AND @timestamp < TO_DATETIME(?end)
| WHERE message LIKE "*blockedURL*" OR message LIKE "*blocked-uri*"
| EVAL m = REPLACE(REPLACE(message, """\\["]""", "\""), """["]\s*:\s*["]""", "\":\"")
| DISSECT m """%{}"blockedURL":"%{b1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"blocked-uri":"%{b2}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"effectiveDirective":"%{d1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"effective-directive":"%{d2}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"sourceFile":"%{s1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"source-file":"%{s2}"%{}"""
| EVAL blocked = COALESCE(b1, b2, ""), directive = COALESCE(d1, d2, "?"), source = COALESCE(s1, s2, "")
| WHERE NOT (blocked LIKE "*-extension*" OR source LIKE "*-extension*")
| DISSECT blocked "%{}://%{rest}"
| EVAL h = REPLACE(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(MV_FIRST(SPLIT(rest, "/")), "?")), ":443$", "")
| EVAL host = CASE(blocked == "", "inline", h IS NULL OR h == "", blocked, h)
| STATS seen = MIN(@timestamp), value = SUM(CASE(@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start), 1, 0)) BY host
| WHERE seen >= TO_DATETIME(?end) - 24 hours
| KEEP host, value
checks.title: CSP blocks {host}
checks.text: Browsers blocked {host} {value} times in the last hour, a host the CSP reports first showed in the last 24 hours, after none in the 7 days before. A new vendor script (often added through a tag manager), an injected script, or an allowance missing after a CSP change: check who loads it (the source file, the page) before adding it to the policy.

checks.name: CSP ${name} report jump
checks.query:
FROM ${index}
| WHERE (@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start) AND @timestamp < TO_DATETIME(?end)) OR (@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start) - 1 day AND @timestamp < TO_DATETIME(?end) - 1 day) OR (@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start) - 7 days AND @timestamp < TO_DATETIME(?end) - 7 days)
| WHERE message LIKE "*blockedURL*" OR message LIKE "*blocked-uri*"
| EVAL m = REPLACE(REPLACE(message, """\\["]""", "\""), """["]\s*:\s*["]""", "\":\"")
| DISSECT m """%{}"blockedURL":"%{b1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"blocked-uri":"%{b2}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"effectiveDirective":"%{d1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"effective-directive":"%{d2}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"sourceFile":"%{s1}"%{}"""
| DISSECT m """%{}"source-file":"%{s2}"%{}"""
| EVAL blocked = COALESCE(b1, b2, ""), directive = COALESCE(d1, d2, "?"), source = COALESCE(s1, s2, "")
| WHERE NOT (blocked LIKE "*-extension*" OR source LIKE "*-extension*")
| EVAL slot = CASE(@timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start), "now", @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?start) - 1 day, "day", "week")
| STATS value = SUM(CASE(slot == "now", 1, 0)), day_ago = SUM(CASE(slot == "day", 1, 0)), week_ago = SUM(CASE(slot == "week", 1, 0))
| EVAL usual = GREATEST(day_ago, week_ago, TO_LONG(1))
| WHERE value >= 100 AND value >= 5 * usual
| KEEP value, day_ago, week_ago
checks.title: CSP reports jumped to {value} an hour
checks.text: Browsers sent {value} CSP violation reports in the last hour, against {day_ago} in the same hour a day ago and {week_ago} a week ago. A policy change that dropped a host, a new script on the site, or a browser change: compare the directives with the last change to the policy.
